headline: Clinton order hands certain presidential powers over the Naval Petroleum and Oil Shale Reserves to another federal official.
what_it_does: This executive order delegates, or passes along, some of the President's legal authority over the Naval Petroleum and Oil Shale Reserves to another official in the executive branch. These reserves are federally owned lands set aside for oil and oil shale. No summary was provided, so the exact powers delegated and who received them are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies managing the Naval Petroleum and Oil Shale Reserves
who_it_affects.how: The order changes which official can make certain decisions about the reserves instead of the President.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on September 29, 1994, though the source does not state this.
